5451.title: Windows startup registration and antivirus compatibility
5451.rootCauseOneLine: Trusted code registers an inline hidden-PowerShell Run-key command and propagates registry failures; Bitdefender causality is unverified.
5451.proposedFix: Obtain a native Windows/Bitdefender detector trace and test a supported startup approach before changing persistence behavior.
5451.caveats: Same-agent command-generation diagnostic passed in two clean trusted checkouts. No Windows registry write, Bitdefender alert, or full enrollment failure was reproduced; the diagnostic is inline in the report. No safe automatic fix.
